known_limits: Fraction-form and cents-form items partly measure answer formatting, not only arithmetic.

scope: Authored parameterised capability tasks with machine-derived answers. Not benchmark items: no public corpus, no human annotation, no leaderboard claim. They measure capability retention as a same-suite paired change, nothing else.
